title: Least-Privilege Kubernetes RBAC for a Deployer Service Account
description: Create a service account that can roll out Deployments in one namespace and nothing else, prove the boundary with impersonation and a real short-lived token, and audit the cluster for wildcard roles and anonymous access.

steps.title: Step 1: the identity, the role, the binding
Step 2: prove the boundary with impersonation
Step 3: a real token, in a kubeconfig that has nothing else
Step 5: audit the cluster you already have
